name: A held slot cannot be confirmed for another household

statusDetails.message: Request: after apartment 12 held Tuesday 17:00 in pukuhuone 8, POST /api/standing-slots/request {"apartment":3,"dressingRoom":"pukuhuone 8","weekday":"Tuesday","startTime":"17:00"}. Observed: HTTP 409 {"ok":false,"reason":"slot_held","message":"The slot on Tuesday at 17:00 in pukuhuone 8 is already held.","holder":12}. Re-read: schedule holder remains 12; posted list still shows only apartment 12 for that slot. Consequence: the second household is refused because the slot is held, and apartment 12 still holds it.
